title: Thanksgiving Feast
intro: [excited] Happy Thanksgiving, everybody! Loosen those belts, because today's board is a five-course feast of Disney trivia. [laughs] Leftovers are NOT allowed, so clean your plates!

art.prompt: A cozy autumn harvest table piled with a golden roast turkey, pumpkin pies, cranberry sauce and a cornucopia, warm candlelight, falling maple leaves outside a window, a faint castle silhouette on the hill. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Little Chef, Big Feast
categories.intro: Our film category is cooking up Ratatouille, the Pixar classic that proved anyone can cook. Even a rat. [chuckles] ESPECIALLY a rat.

art.prompt: A tiny chef's toque resting beside a bubbling copper pot in a bustling Parisian restaurant kitchen at night, the Eiffel Tower glowing through a window. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Ratatouille, Remy the rat secretly cooks by tugging on the hair of this clumsy young kitchen worker
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alfredo Linguini. [laughs] Named after a pasta, which is honestly the most chef thing ever.

clues.clue: Remy's culinary hero is this late chef, whose famous motto was 'Anyone can cook!'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Auguste Gusteau. He also appears as a figment of Remy's imagination, which is the best kind of cooking coach. [whispers] No yelling.

clues.clue: This tough, motorcycle-riding chef is the only woman on the line in Gusteau's kitchen and trains Linguini
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Colette Tatou. Her big rule: keep your station clean. [sighs] Words to live by during Thanksgiving dish duty.

clues.clue: The star of Lawrence of Arabia gave voice to the fearsome food critic Anton Ego
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Peter O'Toole. Ego's office is shaped like a coffin, because he doesn't like food, he loves it. [dramatic pause] If he doesn't love it... he doesn't swallow.

clues.clue: The elegant, thinly sliced ratatouille Remy serves Ego was styled by chef Thomas Keller after this variation of the dish
clues.reveal: The correct answer is confit byaldi, a version of ratatouille made popular by French chef Michel Guerard. Thomas Keller, of The French Laundry, consulted on the film. [excited] FANCY!

categories.title: Pass the Gravy
categories.intro: Pass the Gravy is all about the most memorable meals in Disney films. [mischievously] Napkins on laps, please.

art.prompt: An ornate gravy boat pouring rich gravy over mashed potatoes on a fancy banquet table with candelabras, a plate of spaghetti and a shiny red apple nearby. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Snow White falls into a sleeping death after one bite of this poisoned fruit
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an apple. Moral of the story: [chuckles] always buy your produce from a licensed vendor, not a cackling old lady.

clues.clue: Behind Tony's restaurant, Lady and the Tramp share a plate of this dish, leading to their famous kiss
clues.reveal: The correct answer is spaghetti and meatballs. Walt Disney actually cut the noodle scene after seeing the storyboards, until animator Frank Thomas brought it back. [excited] ICONIC!

clues.clue: In The Princess and the Frog, Tiana's daddy taught her that this Louisiana stew brings people together
clues.reveal: The correct answer is gumbo. Tiana's dad James says food brings folks together from all walks of life. [sighs] That's the whole point of Thanksgiving, right there.

clues.clue: During 'Be Our Guest', Lumiere urges Belle to try this mystery dish, adding 'it's delicious, don't believe me, ask the dishes'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the grey stuff. Be Our Guest Restaurant in Magic Kingdom has famously served its own sweet version for dessert. [laughs] Much better than it sounds.

clues.clue: In Big Hero 6, Hiro and Tadashi's Aunt Cass runs this San Fransokyo coffee shop
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Lucky Cat Cafe. Aunt Cass stress-eats when she's worried, which is... exactly my Thanksgiving strategy too. [chuckles]

categories.title: Fowl Play
categories.intro: It wouldn't be Thanksgiving without a bird on the table. Our fan category is Fowl Play: famous Disney birds. [laughs] Gobble gobble!

art.prompt: A playful barnyard of feathered birds: a proud turkey, a sailor-hat-shaped puddle, colorful parrot feathers floating through warm autumn light. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: This famous Disney duck wears a blue sailor shirt and cap, but never any pants
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Donald Duck. He's been skipping pants since 1934, and honestly, after a big Thanksgiving dinner... [sighs] I get it.

clues.clue: In Aladdin, Jafar's loud-mouthed parrot sidekick is named this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Iago, voiced by Gilbert Gottfried. Named after the villain from Shakespeare's Othello, because even parrots need a literary education. [chuckles]

clues.clue: In Up, Russell gives this name to the giant, chocolate-loving, rainbow-feathered bird, before learning she's a mom
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kevin. Fun fact: Kevin's colorful feathers were inspired by the Himalayan monal pheasant. [excited] Snipe hunting, but make it FANCY.

clues.clue: Zazu, the Lion King's fussy royal advisor, is this kind of bird
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a red-billed hornbill. Rowan Atkinson voiced him in 1994, and honestly nobody does exasperated better than Mr. Bean. [laughs]

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, mice Bernard and Bianca catch a flight with Orville, a pilot who is this kind of big seabird
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an albatross, voiced by Jim Jordan. In The Rescuers Down Under, his brother Wilbur takes over. Orville and Wilbur, like the Wright brothers. [laughs] Get it?

categories.title: Emoji Leftovers
categories.intro: Emoji Leftovers! I'll serve you a plate of emoji plus a little hint, and you tell me the Disney film. [excited] Dig in!

art.prompt: Leftover containers in an open glowing refrigerator, each holding a different colorful smiley-face-shaped food, cozy late-night kitchen. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: ⛄❄️👭👑 Hint: Some people are worth melting for
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen. [singing] Let it go, let it go... and pass the cranberry sauce.

clues.clue: 🎈🏠👴👦 Hint: Adventure is out there!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Up. That opening montage still gets me every single time. [sighs] Somebody pass me the tissues... and the pie.

clues.clue: 🐻🍯🎈🌳 Hint: Oh bother
accept: the many adventures of winnie the pooh
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Winnie the Pooh. The silly old bear's honey pot is the only side dish he needs this Thanksgiving.

clues.clue: 🏹👧🐻🎂 Hint: Mum, that's a lot of cake
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Brave. Moral of the story: never accept baked goods from a woodcarver-slash-witch. [laughs] Merida's mom learned that one the FURRY way.

clues.clue: 🧪🦙👑🕳️ Hint: Pull the lever, Kronk!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Emperor's New Groove. [sarcastic] Wrong lever! Why do we even HAVE that lever?

categories.title: Turkey Leg Tour
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category is the Turkey Leg Tour, all about the tastiest snacks and feasts in the parks. [chuckles] Bring your stretchy pants.

art.prompt: A theme park snack cart at golden hour with giant smoked turkey legs, pineapple soft-serve swirls, churros and pretzels, Victorian main street lamps behind. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Sold at Aloha Isle in Magic Kingdom's Adventureland, this frozen pineapple soft-serve is a legendary park snack
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Dole Whip. Pro tip: get it as a float with pineapple juice. [excited] Your taste buds will thank you.

clues.clue: These giant, smoky drumsticks are so famous at Disney parks that they have their own fan merchandise
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the turkey leg. It's basically Thanksgiving dinner you can carry in one hand. [laughs] Caveman chic!

clues.clue: Named for a famous colonial symbol of protest, this Liberty Square restaurant at Magic Kingdom serves an all-you-care-to-enjoy, Thanksgiving-style feast of roast turkey and stuffing
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Liberty Tree Tavern. Thanksgiving dinner every day of the year, and nobody makes you do the dishes. [chuckles]

clues.clue: At Disneyland's Blue Bayou, overlooking Pirates of the Caribbean, guests famously order this deep-fried, powdered-sugar-dusted sandwich
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Monte Cristo. Turkey, ham and cheese, battered, fried and dusted with sugar. [dramatic pause] It's not a sandwich... it's a LIFESTYLE.

clues.clue: Gaston's Tavern in Magic Kingdom serves this frozen apple-juice drink topped with passion-fruit-mango foam
clues.reveal: The correct answer is LeFou's Brew. [excited] No one sips like LeFou! It tastes a bit like a toasted marshmallow apple, which is very on brand for autumn.
